notes: Anker Nano 20 W USB-C PD charger, label 'Model: A2633'. The unit iFixit opened has a label reading 200-240 V~ input and a CCC mark, which is the China-market approval, so a unit for another market may carry a different label or parts.

gaps: The guide never says China market; that reading comes from its CCC certification and fixed national-standard pins.
The guide gives the main chip as 'INN3265C' with no ordering suffix; the LCSC datasheet page is titled for INN3265C-H202-TL, which is taken as the same family. The suffix on the unit is not known.
The label gives 5 V 3 A and 9 V 2.22 A; the 20 W figure is the guide's name and conclusion, not a label line.
The guide mentions Y capacitors in the plural on the secondary board but shows one close-up, so no Y capacitor count is set.
The Y capacitor, common-mode inductor and transformer have no ratings or markings in the guide.
No datasheets were found for the UBIQ QN0102M6N or QM3017AM3.
The guide gives no production years, so the record has none.
method: iFixit teardown guide 159895 (a community-contributed translation), read through the iFixit guide API; step text only, photos not read. No other teardown site was used.

LCSC datasheet links for INN3265C-H202-TL (C567492) and CYPD3175-24LQXQ (C475898): both open with no bot check and are titled with the part name, but neither returns a readable PDF. No field rests on them.

comps.spec: Label: Model A2633, input 200-240 V~ 50 Hz 0.6 A, output 5 V 3 A and 9 V 2.22 A (the guide's test lists the same USB-C PD levels). The guide calls it a 20 W charger.

Power Integrations (PI) INN3265C main controller: built-in primary PWM controller, switch and secondary synchronous-rectification controller. It sits on the small board that joins the primary and secondary sides.
Cypress CYPD3175 USB PD protocol IC on the back of the secondary board. The guide says the secondary protocol chip controls the output voltage.
UBIQ QN0102M6N secondary synchronous-rectifier NMOS, 100 V, 6 milliohm on-resistance, on the back of the secondary board
UBIQ QM3017AM3 PMOS, 30 V, the USB-C output VBUS switch
Chongqing Pingwei ABSR210 rectifier bridge, 2 A, 1000 V reverse withstand, on the back of the primary board
Two SAMXON high-voltage filter electrolytic capacitors, 10 uF 400 V each
Aihua 50 V 10 uF, the supply capacitor for the main control chip
Man Yue ULR series 16 V 470 uF solid capacitor, the synchronous-rectification output filter
Blue Y capacitor for output interference suppression, from Dongguan Chengxi Electronics
Common-mode inductor, used to filter EMI
USB-C socket with a blue plastic core, through-hole soldered
Transformer fixed with glue between the input and output boards, wrapped in insulating tape, with an information label on its side
